prompt: A general motors vehicle is named after the largest ward in the country of Monaco.  How many people had walked on the moon as of the first model year of the vehicle? Note: the model year is not the same as the year the model was first produced.
answer:
The vehicle is the **Chevrolet Monte Carlo**, named after Monte Carlo, Monaco’s largest quarter (or ward). Although it was first produced and introduced in 1969, its **first model year was 1970**.

By the end of 1970, **four people had walked on the Moon**:

- Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin — Apollo 11 (1969)
- Charles “Pete” Conrad and Alan Bean — Apollo 12 (1969)

**Answer: 4 people.**
